The Panel of Experts has identified several entities involved in violating UN Security Council sanctions.

Korea Mining Development Corporation (KOMID) continues to be the primary arms dealer and main exporter of goods
and equipment related to ballistic missiles and conventional weapons. KOMID has offices in multiple countries
and uses front companies to evade sanctions.

Kim Chol Sam, a KOMID representative based in Dalian, China, has been facilitating financial transactions
on behalf of the Korean People's Army. He reportedly operates through shell companies registered in
Singapore and the United Arab Emirates.

The vessel Wise Honest, flagged under various flags of convenience, has been involved in the illicit
export of coal from North Korea in violation of Security Council resolutions. The ship was last tracked
near the port of Nampo.

Koryo Bank, a state-owned financial institution in Pyongyang, has been used to circumvent international
financial restrictions. Multiple accounts at Koryo Bank have been linked to weapons procurement activities.

The Reconnaissance General Bureau (RGB), North Korea's primary intelligence agency, oversees a number
of cyber operations targeting financial institutions worldwide. The Bureau operates units that conduct
cryptocurrency theft and ransomware attacks.
